icons.label: T cell
icons.description: A resting lymphocyte with a large round nucleus and scant cytoplasm; a single surface receptor is a schematic lineage cue.
icons.scope: T-cell lineage is not identifiable from naked cell morphology; the receptor mark is schematic context, not a diagnostic marker.

icons.label: B cell
icons.description: A resting lymphocyte with a large round nucleus and scant cytoplasm; paired surface receptors cue B-cell context.
icons.scope: Generic B-lymphocyte schematic; the receptor symbols are contextual cues, not a diagnostic morphology claim.

icons.label: Plasma cell
icons.description: An antibody-secreting cell with eccentric round nucleus, cartwheel-like chromatin, abundant cytoplasm, and a perinuclear Golgi hof.
icons.scope: Generic mature plasma-cell schematic; simplified chromatin and Golgi clearing are educational cues.

icons.label: NK cell
icons.description: A large granular lymphocyte with a round nucleus, expanded pale cytoplasm, and cytotoxic granules.
icons.scope: Generic NK-cell schematic; granules are simplified and do not specify activation or target engagement.

icons.label: Dendritic cell
icons.description: A central cell body with long, branching dendritic processes and a central nucleus.
icons.scope: Generic dendritic-cell schematic; process geometry is simplified and not a specific subtype.

icons.label: Macrophage
icons.description: An irregular tissue phagocyte with broad cytoplasm, a folded nucleus, and one phagosome containing cargo.
icons.scope: Generic tissue macrophage; engulfed cargo is schematic and does not show a specific pathogen.

icons.label: Monocyte
icons.description: A circulating mononuclear cell with abundant cytoplasm, a kidney-shaped nucleus, and sparse vacuoles.
icons.scope: Generic circulating monocyte; nuclear contour and cytoplasmic vacuoles are simplified.

icons.label: Neutrophil
icons.description: A granulocyte with a multilobed nucleus connected by narrow bridges and fine cytoplasmic granules.
icons.scope: Generic mature neutrophil; segmentation and fine granules are simplified.

icons.label: Eosinophil
icons.description: A granulocyte with a bilobed nucleus and abundant coarse eosinophilic granules.
icons.scope: Generic mature eosinophil; warm granule color represents staining convention, not molecular composition.

icons.label: Basophil
icons.description: A granulocyte with an S-shaped nucleus partly obscured by coarse basophilic granules.
icons.scope: Generic mature basophil; granules are schematic and partially cover the nucleus.

icons.label: Mast cell
icons.description: A round tissue cell with a central mononuclear nucleus and dense metachromatic cytoplasmic granules.
icons.scope: Generic intact tissue mast cell; subtype, tissue location, and activation state are not specified.

icons.label: Regulatory T cell
icons.description: A lymphocyte with a large round nucleus and scant cytoplasm; repeated surface symbols cue a marker-rich regulatory phenotype.
icons.scope: Treg identity cannot be inferred from naked morphology; repeated surface symbols are schematic marker cues only, not a diagnostic or quantitative phenotype.

icons.label: IFNγ dimer
icons.description: Compact IFNγ homodimer shown as two interlocking antiparallel protomers.
icons.scope: IFNγ homodimer schematic; full receptor complex stoichiometry is 2 IFNγ:2 IFNGR1:2 IFNGR2. Contact markers are schematic, not atomic interfaces.

icons.label: IFNGR1
icons.description: Single-pass receptor chain with two connected extracellular domains and a JAK-binding cytoplasmic tail.
icons.scope: One receptor chain only. The complete IFNγ signaling complex contains 2 IFNγ, 2 IFNGR1 and 2 IFNGR2 chains.

icons.label: IFNGR2
icons.description: Single-pass receptor chain with two connected extracellular domains and a JAK-binding cytoplasmic tail.
icons.scope: One receptor chain only. The complete IFNγ signaling complex contains 2 IFNγ, 2 IFNGR1 and 2 IFNGR2 chains.

icons.label: JAK1
icons.description: Receptor-associated JAK with connected FERM-SH2, pseudokinase and catalytic kinase regions.
icons.scope: Schematic JAK domain architecture; kinase activation state is not encoded.

icons.label: JAK2
icons.description: Receptor-associated JAK with connected FERM-SH2, pseudokinase and catalytic kinase regions.
icons.scope: Schematic JAK domain architecture; kinase activation state is not encoded.

icons.label: STAT1
icons.description: Continuous STAT monomer silhouette with DNA-binding, SH2 and Y701 activation-tail landmarks.
icons.scope: Continuous STAT monomer schematic with exposed SH2, pY-tail, DNA-binding, and importin-alpha5 surfaces; reciprocal pY–SH2 dimer contact is summarized by dimer-interface.

icons.label: STAT3
icons.description: Continuous STAT monomer silhouette with DNA-binding, SH2 and Y705 activation-tail landmarks.
icons.scope: Continuous STAT monomer schematic with exposed SH2, pY-tail, DNA-binding, and importin-alpha5 surfaces; reciprocal pY–SH2 dimer contact is summarized by dimer-interface.

icons.label: STAT5
icons.description: Continuous STAT monomer silhouette with DNA-binding, SH2 and Y694/699 activation-tail landmarks.
icons.scope: Continuous STAT monomer schematic with exposed SH2, pY-tail, DNA-binding, and importin-alpha5 surfaces; reciprocal pY–SH2 dimer contact is summarized by dimer-interface.

icons.label: Importin α5
icons.description: Curved armadillo-repeat solenoid presenting a STAT1-dimer cargo groove.
icons.scope: Importin-α5 cartoon; phospho-STAT1 recognizes a nonclassical import surface.

icons.label: Importin β1
icons.description: Flexible helical-repeat solenoid linking importin α cargo adaptor to nuclear-pore transport.
icons.scope: Generic importin-β1 transport schematic; no transport cycle state is implied.

icons.label: GAS DNA
icons.description: Double-stranded DNA with an illustrative central γ-activated sequence contact region.
icons.scope: Double-stranded GAS response element schematic; the central sequence is highlighted, and the opposing strands cross in this 2D helix convention.

icons.label: RNA polymerase II
icons.description: Compact asymmetric polymerase clamp with an explicit DNA cleft and nascent-transcription exit.
icons.scope: Compact polymerase clamp with a DNA cleft. A short embedded DNA helix is contextual art and can be omitted when the scene supplies promoter DNA.

icons.label: Nuclear pore cutaway
icons.description: Side-view pore cutaway with a compact ring-stack scaffold, double-membrane context and open central channel.
icons.scope: Side-view nuclear pore cutaway with open 44-unit channel; membrane stubs are context and midplane anchors mark the source double-envelope coordinates.

icons.label: Phospholipid
icons.description: Phospholipid with a polar head and two flexible hydrocarbon tails for bilayer assembly.
icons.scope: Generic schematic; geometry supports a reusable bilayer rig.

icons.label: Membrane patch
icons.description: A bilayer patch with polar head groups facing outward and hydrocarbon tails meeting at the core.
icons.scope: Generic bilayer schematic; individual lipid positions are illustrative.

icons.label: Single-pass receptor
icons.description: A single-pass receptor with a shallow extracellular binding cup and one cytosolic tail.
icons.scope: Generic schematic, not a named molecular structure; binding contour is designed for teaching-scale docking.

icons.label: Ligand
icons.description: A soluble ligand with a narrow downward protrusion shaped to meet a receptor cup.
icons.scope: Generic schematic, not a named molecular structure; shares a complementary teaching-scale contact profile with the receptor icon.

icons.label: Ion channel
icons.description: A membrane-spanning pore with a clear aqueous lumen and ions in transit.
icons.scope: Generic schematic; does not represent a specific channel family or gating state.

icons.label: GPCR
icons.description: A seven-helix membrane receptor with extracellular and intracellular connecting loops.
icons.scope: Generic seven-transmembrane schematic, not a named receptor or resolved structure.

icons.label: Membrane transporter
icons.description: Two carrier domains form a central substrate-binding cavity across a bilayer.
icons.scope: Generic alternating-access carrier schematic; no particular transport cycle state is implied.

icons.label: Vesicle
icons.description: A membrane-bound vesicle with a clear lumen and a small cargo set.
icons.scope: Generic schematic; size and cargo composition are illustrative.

icons.label: Multivesicular endosome
icons.description: A sorting endosome with a tubule and intraluminal vesicles carrying cargo.
icons.scope: A multivesicular endosome schematic with lumenal vesicles; not a universal early-endosome morphology.

icons.label: Lysosome
icons.description: A membrane-bound degradative compartment with enzymes and digestate fragments.
icons.scope: Generic schematic; enzyme and digestate symbols are illustrative.

icons.label: Clathrin triskelion
icons.description: A three-legged clathrin triskelion with curved legs and distal globular domains.
icons.scope: Schematic triskelion unit, not a three-dimensional coat or a complete lattice.

icons.label: Fusion protein
icons.description: A four-helix zipper bundle bridges two apposed membranes in a SNARE-like fusion schematic.
icons.scope: Generic trans-SNARE-like teaching schematic; not a named complex or resolved structure.

icons.label: Protein Globular
icons.description: Globular folded protein schematic with an exposed binding surface.
icons.scope: Generic schematic, not a named molecular structure.

icons.label: Protein Two Domain
icons.description: Two linked folded domains with a flexible interdomain connection.
icons.scope: Generic schematic, not a named molecular structure.

icons.label: Transcription Factor
icons.description: DNA-bound transcription factor with paired recognition domains.
icons.scope: Generic schematic, not a named molecular structure.

icons.label: Coactivator
icons.description: Modular scaffold protein with multiple interaction domains.
icons.scope: Generic schematic, not a named molecular structure.

icons.label: Enzyme
icons.description: Generic folded enzyme with a shallow right-facing substrate pocket.
icons.scope: Generic schematic, not a named molecular structure.

icons.label: Substrate
icons.description: Generic molecular substrate with a matching shallow left-facing protrusion.
icons.scope: Generic schematic, not a named molecular structure.

icons.label: Kinase
icons.description: Bilobal kinase schematic with an ATP-like nucleotide in its active cleft.
icons.scope: Generic schematic, not a named molecular structure.

icons.label: Phosphatase
icons.description: Phosphatase schematic engaging a phosphate-bearing peptide segment.
icons.scope: Generic schematic, not a named molecular structure.

icons.label: Ubiquitin
icons.description: Compact beta-grasp fold with a free C-terminal conjugation tail.
icons.scope: Generic schematic, not a named molecular structure.

icons.label: Antibody
icons.description: Bivalent Y-shaped immunoglobulin with two antigen-binding arms.
icons.scope: Generic schematic, not a named molecular structure.

icons.label: Antibody Fab
icons.description: Single antigen-binding antibody fragment with paired chains.
icons.scope: Generic schematic, not a named molecular structure.

icons.label: Protein Dimer
icons.description: Two protein protomers joined at a complementary interface.
icons.scope: Generic schematic, not a named molecular structure.

icons.label: TNF trimer
icons.description: Three-subunit TNF ligand arranged around its receptor-facing interface.
icons.scope: Trimeric ligand schematic; subunit contours and receptor-facing surface are illustrative, not a solved TNF structure.

icons.label: TNFR1
icons.description: Single-pass TNFR1 with four extracellular cysteine-rich modules and a cytosolic death domain.
icons.scope: Canonical TNFR1 topology schematic; cysteine-rich domains and death-domain geometry are simplified.

icons.label: TRADD
icons.description: TRADD adaptor with an N-terminal TRAF-interacting region linked to a C-terminal death-domain bundle.
icons.scope: Domain-order schematic of TRADD; the two interaction regions are not an atomic structure.

icons.label: RIPK1
icons.description: RIPK1 domain map with N-terminal kinase, ubiquitin-modified intermediate region, and C-terminal death domain.

icons.label: TRAF2
icons.description: TRAF2 trimer schematic with N-terminal RING region, coiled-coil stalk, and C-terminal TRAF domains.

icons.label: TAK1

icons.label: IKK complex

icons.label: IκBα

icons.label: RELA / p65

icons.label: NFKB1 / p50

icons.label: Centrosome
